manifest.name: tags
manifest.description: Watcher tags, loop stop clause, strings and animation

commands.name: stopticker
commands.description: Stop the loop via its stop clause

source: fn pulse(args, config) { let s = strings.seen_photo; #{frames: ["◐ " + s, "◓ " + s, "◑ " + s], frame_ms: 300} } fn stopticker(args, config) { let s = if type_of(state) == "map" { state } else { #{} }; s.ticker_alive = false; #{state: s, text: "ticker stopped"} } fn on_photo(event, config) { let s = if type_of(state) == "map" { state } else { #{} }; s.photos = s.photos + 1; #{state: s, text: strings.seen_photo} } fn on_question(event, config) { #{text: strings.asked} } fn on_group_mention(event, config) { #{text: "mentioned: " + event.sender} } fn ticker(event, config) { #{text: "tick " + event.time} }
